title: Let's build something *together*.
intro: Hiring for a product design role, or have a UI/UX or 3D project in mind? Send a message — I reply within 24 hours.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: UI/UX projects usually take 2–6 weeks and 3D modelling 1–4 weeks, depending on scope.
I combine UX process with a VFX and 3D background — so I think about depth, light and motion as well as flows and usability.

faq.q: What does your process look like?
faq.a: Discovery, personas, wireframes, prototypes, testing, then a clean handoff to development.
